text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed humps on Chipstead Road, between York Mills Road and Harlington Road. Staff's assessment indicates the criteria as set out in the updated Traffic Calming Policy has been satisfied. Therefore, speed humps should be installed on Chipstead Road, between York Mills Road and Harlington Road.

North York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (2 speed humps) on Chipstead Road, between York Mills Road and Harlington Road / Ames Gate, generally as shown in Attachment 2, Drawing Number TC-668, dated March 2026, to the report (April 13, 2026) from the Director, Enforcement and Street Management, Transportation Services.
